data.name: Janavika
data.gender_notes: Janavika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Janavika is derived from Sanskrit words 'Jan' meaning 'people' and 'Vik' meaning 'knowledge'. The name signifies a woman who is knowledgeable about the people and their needs, a wise leader and a nurturer. In Hindu mythology, Janavika is a name of a goddess who is revered for her wisdom and compassion. The name Janavika carries the meaning “Lady of the Sacred Word” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Janavika usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the sacred word and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Janavika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady of the Sacred Word.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janavika total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
